## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt` leaves the tree unchanged
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` is clean
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] New or changed UI strings are added to `locales/app.yml` for `en`,
      `zh-CN`, and `zh-TW`
- [ ] If dependencies changed, `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` was regenerated
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, keys, or personal data are included
- [ ] Commits follow the Conventional Commits style used in this repo
